name: loopky
description: Anki-style spaced-repetition flashcards from Codex: build a deck from any topic, import an Anki .apkg or a TSV, add pictures and a language pair for listening and speaking practice, then study it in the free Loopky app on Android and iOS.

interface.longDescription: Ask for flashcards and Codex builds a Loopky deck with the loopky CLI: from a topic, your notes or an existing Anki .apkg. It checks the network, signs you in with Pubky Ring, dry-runs before writing and verifies what was stored. Language decks get a declared pair, so the free Loopky app on Android and iOS can read cards aloud and grade spoken answers. Decks are public; the CLI can write only Loopky's own data.
defaultPrompt: Make me 20 Spanish flashcards for ordering food, with Listen and Speak
Import my Anki deck deck.apkg into Loopky
Turn these notes into a Loopky flashcard deck
